about_the_game:
Take your faction to the next level with the MyFACTION Diamond Plus Pack. Whether you’re building a dangerous new faction or doubling down on dominance, this pack delivers a stacked lineup of Superstars, card packs, and VC.

The MyFACTION Diamond Plus Pack includes:

  • 32,500 VC

  • Karrion Kross Diamond Evolution Card

  • Jade Cargill Diamond Evolution Card

  • Bron Breakker Diamond Evolution Card

  • Alexa Bliss Diamond Evolution Card

  • Sol Ruca Live Event Requirement Card (August)

  • Je'Von Evans Live Event Requirement Card (September)

  • 1x Deluxe Bloodline Series Pack

  • 1x Deluxe Legends Series 2 Pack

  • 1x Deluxe Punches & Promos Pack

  • 1x Deluxe Sinister Series Pack

  • 2x Basic Money in the Bank Packs

  • 1x Basic Bloodline Series Pack

  • 1x Basic Legends Series 2 Pack

  • 1x Basic Punches & Promos Pack

  • 1x Basic Sinister Series 1 Pack

  • 2x Deluxe Demastered Series Packs

  • 2x Deluxe Legends Series 1 Packs

  • 2x Deluxe Fierce Series 1 Packs

  • 2x Deluxe Ascent Series Packs

  • 2x Deluxe Electric Series 1 Packs

  • 2x Deluxe Tempest Packs

  • 2x Deluxe Money in the Bank Packs

*Online play including MyFACTION and MyGM requires an Internet connection and 2K Account. Console online play requires a separate paid subscription. Terms apply.
